changes: Adds one English execution-plan decision doc: docs/requirements/decisions/lattice-experience-layer-execution-plan.md (plan only, no source code). Records the Lattice Experience Layer design: advisory-only review-playbook layer; module decomposition (4 core + 2 handler, one-way inward coupling); reuse of dev-memory / decision-doc-promotion digest / activity-log; cut FTS for v1; three determinism guardrails; phased roadmap with Phase 1a first; code-anchor appendix. No Co-Authored-By trailer.
usage: Read the plan: cat docs/requirements/decisions/lattice-experience-layer-execution-plan.md. It is the authoritative v1.1 spec for implementing the Experience Layer; the first implementation story is Phase 1a (finding-signals slice).
expectedOutcome: ls docs/requirements/decisions/lattice-experience-layer-execution-plan.md prints the path; head shows '# Lattice Experience Layer Execution Plan' then '> Story: B-1480' then a plan-only scope note. The doc has Problem/Principles/Architecture(module decomposition+reuse+cut-FTS)/Determinism Guardrails(3)/Roadmap(Phase 1a first)/What-not-to-do/Code-anchor appendix sections. Verifier prints TOTAL 44 | PASS 44 | FAIL 0.
actualTranscript: verify-b-1480.mjs => TOTAL 44 | PASS 44 | FAIL 0 (fileExists/headersOk/storyHeader/planOnly/advisoryOnly/moduleDecomp/reuse/cutFts/guardrails/backCompat/roadmapFirst/anchorsOk/noTrailer all true). lattice validate => 44/44 covered, 0 required missing. Review round 1: docs/test-coverage/product PASS, quality filed F-001 (lifecycle state inconsistency). After implementer fix (c90aa45c) round 2: concept/quality/test-coverage/docs ALL PASS. Degraded 3x1 escalation fallback REF-mqhgguie recorded (assuranceLevel degraded-single-host, reviewEscalationOk true).
outcomeDiff: No difference — the doc matches the expected structure and the verifier is fully green; the one review finding (F-001) was fixed and re-reviewed clean.
limitations: Plan only — no code is implemented by this story; it is a roadmap whose accuracy is defended by review + the structural verifier, not by a compiler. The escalation status display reads ordinary-review because the gate did not MANDATE escalation (first round had 1<2 countable problems), but a degraded 3x1 (single-host) audit was recorded explicitly at the user's request.
pitfalls: Decision docs in decisions/ are freeform English markdown, not generated by decision_doc_proposal/save. The doc lives in docs/ (material), so any edit changes materialHash and stales reviews + host verdicts — after the F-001 fix I rolled REVIEW->DEV->REVIEW, re-ran all 4 gate reviewers, and re-submitted 3 host verdicts bound to the NEW materialHash. The worktree needed node_modules symlinks + builds before the lattice CLI would run. Story_create --checklist did not carry the files subfield, so the scope contract started empty and had to be set explicitly. Avoid a stray default autopilot_review_submit (no args) — it records a junk blocked verdict.
